user.title: Title of the first setup screen, where the user enters the address of the guide.
user.description: Text at the top of the first setup screen. XMLTV is the name of a file format: do not translate it. gzip, xz and zip are names of compressed file formats.

data.url: Label of the field for the address of the XMLTV file.

data_description.url: Help under the address field. .gz, .xz and .zip are file name endings: do not translate them.

channels.title: Title of the second setup screen, where the user selects channels from the downloaded guide.
channels.description: Text at the top of the channel screen.

data.channels: Label of the list of channels to select.

data_description.channels: Help under the channel list. It tells why the selection matters.

error.cannot_connect: Error at the top of the address screen when the file cannot be downloaded.
error.invalid_guide: Error at the top of the address screen when the file is downloaded, but it is not an XMLTV guide.
error.no_channels: Error under the channel list when the user selects no channel.

abort.already_configured: Shows when the user adds a guide with an address that is already set up.

init.title: Title of the options screen of an integration that is already set up.

data.channels: Label of the list of channels to select.
data.update_interval: Label of the number field for the hours between two downloads of the guide.

data_description.channels: Help under the channel list on the options screen.
data_description.update_interval: Help under the hours field. 1 and 48 are the lowest and the highest value the field accepts.

error.no_channels: Error under the channel list on the options screen when the user selects no channel.

abort.not_loaded: Shows when the user opens the options before the integration has loaded a guide, so there is no channel list yet.

reminder_starting_title.message: Title of the phone notification for a programme that starts soon. {channel_name} is the TV channel name, {time} is the start time (24-hour, for example 20:00). The text under it is only the programme title.

reminder_gone_message.message: Text of the phone notification when a programme with a reminder was removed from the guide. {title} is the programme title.
